notes.title: 🚨 MASSIVE Devlog Update!! 🚨
notes.notes:
I know it has been a *while* since the last Devlog Update, but rest assured, that does not mean we haven't been working hard at developing the game! In fact, it has been the exact opposite of that--we have been ramping up production as we gear toward the encroaching launch of our Kickstarter campaign!

Here are some new features added since our last update:

[b]VASTLY IMPROVED ENVIRONMENTAL ART & DESIGN [/b]
[list]
[*] The game does not look as "bland" and "same-y" as it once did
[*] Lots of environmental assets added and incorporated such as pathways, grass, rocks, flowers, trees, crates (cover), etc.
[*] Various level design improvements
[/list]

[b]NEW ENEMY TYPE: ARMORED ENEMY[/b]
[list]
[*] Base enemies now have a chance to spawn in as an armored variant
[*] Armored enemies are resistant to normal bullets and require explosives or high-powered shots to take them down efficiently
[*] Adds more variety and strategy to combat
[/list]

[b]INCREASED OVERALL GAME DIFFICULTY[/b]
[list]
[*]After much feedback from people wishing for a bit more challenge from the game's combat, the game is now more difficult for those *looking* for a challenge
[*] There are still modes and features in the game that make it easier for those who do not care or want a challenging experience
[*] Let's see how you do against the buffed army of robots >:)
[/list]

[b]MAIN STORY AND SIDE QUESTS IMPLEMENTED[/b]
[list]
[*] Kittens with Cannons is primarily an action-RPG which means the game's narrative will play a heavy role in the overall experience
[*]Side quests will feature unique characters and storylines and *will not* be made with any less effort than the main quests. This means we intend for *all* quests to be meaningful in their creation and implementation. Quests are not meant to feel like chores or tedious fetch-quests to grind levels.
[*] Side quests are completely optional but we encourage you to play them as they grant more rewards and more fun stories!
[/list]

[b]PLAYABLE DEMO NOW RELEASED[/b]
[list]
[*] You can play our demo on Itch.io or Game Jolt, completely free and no download necessary! [url=https://bowtiecatstudios.itch.io/kittens-with-cannons]Demo Link[/url]
[*] Please don't be afraid to send feedback our way
[*] We will be updating the demo as we continue to improve, fix, and add to the game! 
[/list]

There are *a ton* more things, small and large, that we have added to the game, but I will go over those in future Devlog Updates as this one is already long enough. 

Anyways, as always, thank you all for continuing to follow and support the development of Kittens with Cannons. Have an amazing rest of your week and see you all next week for another update! :cat:
